findings.title: Embers stop for good about 16.6 game days after the effecter is spawned
findings.detail: SubEffecter_SprayerChance stops spawning once TicksGame passes its creation tick + def.lifespanMaxTicks, which defaults to 999999 (about 16.6 days). Hediff_Titan.EffectersTick only spawns new effecters when liveEffecters is empty, which needs a CleanupEffecters call (despawn, trait change, reload). A titan that stays spawned longer than that silently loses its particles. Fix in EffectersTick: record the tick the effecters were spawned and call CleanupEffecters() once a period shorter than the lifespan has passed, so the next tick spawns fresh ones. Or set <lifespanMaxTicks> high in TF_Effecter_Embers and say in the docs that authors must do the same.

findings.title: Head overlay uses an absolute layer, so it draws under the body and apparel and the head covers it
findings.detail: PawnRenderNodeWorker.LayerFor returns props.baseLayer as is, not relative to the parent node. The vanilla Head node is at baseLayer 50 and apparel at 2-40. TitanOverlay.MakeProps sets baseLayer = layer (-1 or 1) for the head props too. The rim glow (-1) draws behind the body and the tint (1, the venom example) draws under the head, so neither shows on the head. In MakeProps, use baseLayer = (head ? 50f : 0f) + layer, the parent's vanilla layer plus the offset, which matches the 'relative to the body' doc comment.

findings.title: Animal overlay ignores alternate graphics, so the glow outline can differ from the body under it
findings.detail: Vanilla's animal body node checks pawn.TryGetAlternate(out ag, out _) and draws ag.GetGraphic(stage.bodyGraphicData.Graphic). PawnRenderNode_TitanOverlay.SourceGraphic always reads bodyGraphicData or femaleGraphicData, so on an animal with an alternate graphic the overlay uses a different texture and mesh size from the body. Add the same TryGetAlternate branch to SourceGraphic.

findings.title: Humanlike body overlay always uses the plain naked body path
findings.detail: PawnRenderNode_Body.GraphicFor uses mutant bodyTypeGraphicPaths and creepjoiner form paths when they exist. SourceGraphic always uses bodyType.bodyNakedGraphicPath, so a mutant or creepjoiner with its own body texture gets a glow in the wrong shape. Only Fresh is drawn (rotDrawMode = Fresh), so the dessicated path does not matter.

findings.title: Pulse runs on real time, so it keeps pulsing while the game is paused
findings.detail: PawnRenderNodeWorker_TitanOverlay uses Time.realtimeSinceStartup. That may be what you want. I did not check the corpus for a vanilla precedent either way, so this is opinion.
